user.title: Add mFi device
user.description: Home Assistant takes over the role of the Ubiquiti mFi controller.

ssh.title: Adopt via SSH
ssh.description: Home Assistant logs into the device once over SSH, reads its key and points its inform URL to this server. A backup of the old setting is kept on the device.

data.inform_host: Address of Home Assistant (as seen by the device)
data.keep_key: Keep the existing key (old controller keeps working until the URL is switched back)

manual.title: Manual setup
manual.description: Point the device to `http://<Home Assistant>:<port>/inform` yourself (e.g. via SSH: `mca-ctrl -t connect -s <url> -k <authkey>`). Home Assistant waits for the first inform.

data.mac: MAC address (as sent in the inform header)

progress.provision: Configuring the device and waiting for its first report (up to 90 s)...
progress.wait: Waiting for the first report of the device (up to 90 s)...

error.provision_failed: Configuring the device failed, see the log
error.port_in_use: Inform/STUN port is already in use
error.no_inform: The device did not report within 90 s
error.invalid_key: The authkey must be 32 hex characters
